name: Healing Ward heals and Spirit Idol restores mana through their explicit targets (#265)
contract: Healing Ward 500957 drops creature 50104, 'healing 8 nearby allies ... every $500956T1 sec' with Healing
Ward 805403. Spirit Idol 500961 drops creature 50106: 'Allies ... regenerate $805282s1% maximum mana' with
Energize 805282, EffectBasePoints 3 + 1 = 4% of maximum mana per tick. The summons cast these helpers at
each ally as an explicit unit target. Spell.dbc gives the helpers area targets only (805403
TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY in the spell-attribute hook. #265 counted thousands of skipped helper casts on
release feb155c82, whose explicit-target mask was cached before that hook and dropped the ally. A wounded,
drained Witch Doctor next to both summons must receive an 805403 heal and exactly one 4% mana tick.
Ordinary regeneration is disabled, so health and mana change only through the summons.
